name: Evaluación Ciega de Calidad de Imagen (BRISQUE)
description: Utiliza natural scene statistics to evaluate image quality and detect distortions indicando AI generation or manipulación.
mechanism: Computes locally normalized luminance coeficientes and fits them to a generalized Gaussian distribución. The shape and varianza parameters are used as características para detectar deviations from natural image statistics.
parameters: Patch size: 7×7, MSCN coeficientes, GGD fitting, Features: 36-dimensional, SVR model
source: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP
useCase: Evaluating naturalness of images to flag generado por IA or heavily processed content

references.title: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• No se necesita imagen de referencia
• Fast computation
• Correlates well with human perception
• Detecta multiple distortion types
limitations:
• May not detect high-quality AI images
• Sensitive to legitimate processing
• Requires calibration per domain
• Not specific to any falsificación type
